title: Baidu GenFlow Officially Announces Chinese Name Kuku AI: Launches PC, Web, Mini Program, and Enterprise Edition
excerpt: On August 14, during Baidu's AI Day open day, Baidu Wenku's general-purpose AI agent GenFlow officially announced its Chinese name "Kuku AI" and simultaneously
content_html:
On August 14, during Baidu's AI Day open day, Baidu Wenku's general-purpose AI agent GenFlow officially announced its Chinese name "Kuku AI" and simultaneously launched an independent product matrix. Data shows that GenFlow's monthly active users have exceeded 100 million, and the monthly active users (MAU) for AI office applications have surpassed 25 million.

After this upgrade, Baidu Wenku will further operate "Kuku AI" independently, launching product forms such as the Kuku AI office PC client, Kuku AI web version, Kuku AI mini program, and Kuku AI enterprise version, covering personal office, web use, mobile devices, and enterprise-level application scenarios.

From a user scale perspective, GenFlow has already formed a significant AI application foundation. The launch of the independent "Kuku AI" end also means that Baidu is further strengthening its productization layout of general AI agents in office scenarios. As AI agents evolve from single-function tools to comprehensive intelligent agents covering information processing, content production, and office collaboration, the independent product matrix is expected to further expand its usage scenarios and service boundaries.

content_html_zh:
8月14日，百度AI Day开放日期间，百度文库旗下通用AI代理GenFlow正式公布中文名“酷库AI”，并同步推出独立产品矩阵。 数据显示，GenFlow月活跃用户已突破1亿，AI办公应用月活跃用户（MAU）超过2500万。

此次升级后，百度文库将进一步独立运营“Kuku AI”，推出Kuku AI办公PC客户端、Kuku AI网页版、Kuku AI小程序、Kuku AI企业版等产品形态，覆盖个人办公、网页使用、移动设备、企业级应用场景。

从用户规模来看，GenFlow已经形成了重要的AI应用基础。 独立“酷酷AI”端的推出，也意味着百度进一步强化办公场景通用AI坐席的产品化布局。 随着AI智能体从单一功能工具向涵盖信息处理、内容生产、办公协作等综合智能智能体演进，独立的产品矩阵有望进一步拓展其使用场景和服务边界。
